t: Zappa Records - Wikipedia
s: November 28, 2025 - Zappa Records is an American record label based in Los Angeles which was founded by Frank Zappa in 1977. It was mostly inactive during the 1980s and 1990s, but was revived in 2006 by the Zappa Family Trust. In May 1976, Zappa ended his relationship with manager and business partner Herb Cohen.
